items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...they mentioned Grandma Myrtle? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. What about her? Was it Chris?

ctx.x: Lake Tahoe where I’ll be playing with Chris and Dan. And yeah, yeah, we are busy and we’re setting up a book tour for next year, April of next year. You know setting up a tour means you need kind of an anchor date and then you build things around it. So right now there’s too many moving parts but we know we’re going to be doing something at Jazz at Lincoln Center unless they can’t give us a venue, and if they can’t then we’ll do it at Juilliard or vice versa. But that agreement’s in place. And then we’re going…
So I want to see if — this is just an aside — if you can confirm what your brothers said about discipline in the Brubeck home. And they mentioned Grandma Myrtle?
Yeah. What about her? Was it Chris?
